sentences.text: Court, thereafter, charge-sheet was filed on 20.10.2022 by Investigating Officer.
He further submits that an application under Section 438 Cr.P.C. was filed, thereafter, interim anticipatory bail was granted by this Court to the applicant on 30.09.2022.

He next submits that the applicant does not have any criminal antecedent except the present case and she is ready to cooperate in the trial but charge has not been framed till today, hence, she is entitled for regular anticipatory bail.
4. Shri Piyush Kumar Singh, learned A.G.A. as well as Shri Sidhdharth Sinha, learned counsel for the complainant vehemently opposes the prayer of the applicant.

However, they do not dispute the fact that during the course of investigation, arrest of the applicant was protected by the Writ Court,
thereafter, interim anticipatory bail was granted to the applicant on 30.09.2022.

5. Considering the submissions of learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A., learned counsel for the complainant and going through the contents of the bail application as well as other relevant enclosures; it is evident that on 30.09.2022, interim anticipatory bail was granted to the applicant.

Order dated 30.09.2022 is as under:
"Heard Sri Syed Husain Abbas, learned counsel for the applicant and the learned Additional Government Advocate for the State.
As per learned counsel for the applicant, the present applicant is apprehending her arrest in Case Crime/ FIR No.476 of 2021, under Sections 147, 420, 467, 468, 471,
504 & 506 IPC, Police Station - Thakurganj, District - Lucknow.

Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that the present applicant has been falsely implicated in the case as she has not committed any offence as alleged as alleged in the prosecution story so narrated in the First Information Report (in short F.I.R.).

Attention has been drawn towards the order dated 06.09.2021 passed by this Court in Misc. Bench No.19682 of 2021; Smt. Nafees Fatima & Others vs. State of U.P. &
Others, whereby the Division Bench of this Court has granted interim protection to the applicant till the next date of listing directing the applicant to participate in the investigation.

Therefore, the present applicant is apprehending her arrest in the aforesaid case crime, however, her writ petition is pending.

Sri Abbas has further submitted that in compliance of the order dated 06.09.2021 (supra) passed by the writ Court, the present applicant has cooperated with the investigation and has never flouted the process of law, therefore, her liberty may be protected till conclusion of the trial proceedings.

Let counter affidavit be filed within a period of two weeks.
List this case on 19.10.2022 along with Criminal Misc. Anticipatory Bail Application (U/S 438 Cr.P.C.) No.1581 of 2022.

The charge has not been framed till today and there is no evidence that the applicant misused the liberty of interim anticipatory bail, hence, the applicant is entitled for regular anticipatory bail.
6. Subject to above, the bail application is allowed.

Thus, this Court is of the view that the applicant is entitled for anticipatory bail and in case she is taken into custody, then she shall be released forthwith on anticipatory bail after taking personal bond of Rs. 25,000/- and two sureties each in the like amount with the following conditions:-

sentences.text: (i) The applicant shall not commit or participate in any offence similar to the offence of which she is accused, or suspected, of the commission of which she is suspected.

(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade her from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.

(iii) The applicant shall remain present, in person, before the Trial Court on dates fixed for (1) opening of the case, (2) framing of charge and (3) recording of statement under Section 313 Cr.P.C. If in the opinion of the Trial Court absence of the applicant is deliberate or without sufficient cause, then it shall be open for the Trial Court to treat such default as abuse of liberty of bail and proceed against her in accordance with law.
8. The trial court is directed to conclude the trial expeditiously in accordance with law without giving any unnecessary adjournment to either of the parties.
